title: OpenOTP — your email verification codes, autofilled on your Mac
excerpt: Open-source macOS menu bar app that spots verification codes in your email and fills them for you. No server, works with Gmail and any IMAP provider.
content_html:
Your email verification codes, autofilled on your Mac.

Works with Gmail and any IMAP provider — iCloud, Outlook, Fastmail, … · macOS 13+ · open source

What it does

You paste email verification codes dozens of times a week. OpenOTP is like the way an iPhone surfaces SMS codes above the keyboard, but for the one-time passcodes that land in your email. It watches your inbox, and spots any incoming codes. It presents it to you in three formats:

  • Global shortcut (default ⌃⌥V, customizable) types the latest code into the focused field
  • Floating pill next to the field you're filling
  • Menu-bar list of recent codes, one click to copy, with a 12-hour history

Heads up: this is a simple personal project I built for myself and decided to share, not a polished product. It works well for me, but expect some issues :)

Getting started

  • Install with the command above, or grab the app from Releases
  • Follow the setup wizard — connect with an app password for your email account
  • When a code arrives, press ⌃⌥V, click the pill, or copy it from the menu bar

Filling into other apps needs macOS's Accessibility permission — the same one Raycast and Alfred use. Copying from the menu needs no permission at all.

Private by design

There is no OpenOTP server, so nothing about your email ever touches one. Mail is read directly from your Mac, read-only, using credentials you provide. Detected codes are held in memory only with a short TTL. It's never written to disk, and never logged. Credentials live in the macOS Keychain.

Detection is also deliberately conservative. OpenOTP only shows you something when it's certain it found a code.

Hidden from screen capture

If you're on a call, streaming, or recording your screen, a code on screen is a way into your accounts. OpenOTP guards against this, on by default, toggleable under Preferences → "Hide codes from screen recording":

  • The floating pill (where you read the code) is excluded from all screen capture. It stays fully visible to you, but it's blank in screen recordings, screenshots (⌘⇧5/⌘⇧4), and shares over Zoom, Slack, etc.
  • The menu bar list is drawn by macOS and can't be excluded from capture, so it simply omits the digits — the menu shows "Copy code · sender" (clicking still copies).

One inherent limit: when you actually fill a code, it lands in a real text field on screen, which is capturable like anything else you type — that's true of any autofill. The protection covers OpenOTP's own surfaces.

Building from source

git clone https://github.com/jeninh/OpenOTP
cd OpenOTP
Scripts/bundle.sh release      # builds + packages build/OpenOTP.app
open build/OpenOTP.app

content_html_zh:
您的电子邮件验证码，在您的 Mac 上自动填充。

可与 Gmail 和任何 IMAP 提供商配合使用 — iCloud、Outlook、Fastmail 等 · macOS 13+ · 开源

它的作用

您每周粘贴电子邮件验证码数十次。 OpenOTP 就像 iPhone 在键盘上显示短信代码的方式一样，只不过是在电子邮件中显示一次性密码。 它会监视您的收件箱，并发现任何传入的代码。 它以三种格式呈现给您：

  • 全局快捷键（默认 ⌃⌥V，可自定义）将最新代码键入焦点字段
  • 漂浮在您正在填充的区域旁边的药丸
  • 菜单栏最近代码列表，一键复制，具有 12 小时历史记录

注意：这是我为自己构建并决定分享的一个简单的个人项目，而不是一个精美的产品。 它对我来说效果很好，但预计会出现一些问题:)

入门

  • 使用上面的命令安装，或从发布中获取应用程序
  • 按照设置向导操作 — 使用您的电子邮件帐户的应用程序密码进行连接
  • 当代码到达时，按 ⌃⌥V，单击药丸，或从菜单栏中复制它

填充其他应用程序需要 macOS 的辅助功能权限 - Raycast 和 Alfred 使用的权限相同。 从菜单复制根本不需要许可。

私人设计

没有 OpenOTP 服务器，因此您的电子邮件中的任何内容都不会触及任何服务器。 使用您提供的凭据直接从您的 Mac 读取邮件（只读）。 检测到的代码仅通过短 TTL 保存在内存中。 它从未写入磁盘，也从未记录。 凭证位于 macOS 钥匙串中。

检测也刻意保守。 OpenOTP 仅在确定找到代码时才向您显示某些内容。

从屏幕截图中隐藏

如果您正在通话、流式传输或录制屏幕，屏幕上的代码就是进入您帐户的一种方式。 OpenOTP 可以防止这种情况，默认情况下处于开启状态，可在“首选项”→“隐藏屏幕录制中的代码”下切换：

  • 漂浮的药丸（您阅读代码的地方）被排除在所有屏幕截图之外。 它对您保持完全可见，但在屏幕录制、屏幕截图 (⌘⇧5/⌘⇧4) 以及通过 Zoom、Slack 等共享时为空白。
  • 菜单栏列表是由 macOS 绘制的，无法从捕获中排除，因此它只是省略了数字 - 菜单显示“复制代码·发件人”（单击仍然复制）。

一个固有的限制：当您实际填写代码时，它会出现在屏幕上的真实文本字段中，该文本字段可以像您输入的任何其他内容一样被捕获 - 对于任何自动填充都是如此。 保护覆盖 OpenOTP 自身的表面。

从源头构建

git clone https://github.com/jeninh/OpenOTP
cd OpenOTP
Scripts/bundle.sh release      # builds + packages build/OpenOTP.app
open build/OpenOTP.app
